repos_data.description: AIFT is a GUI, CLI, REST API, and MCP tool that helps DFIR analysts get oriented quickly. Point it at disk images, VM images, forensic archives, or triage packages; AIFT discovers what can be opened, parses artifacts with Dissect, and uses AI to turn parsed data into concrete leads and gaps for the investigator to verify.

Zero-dependency Python CLI for targeted file collection - digital forensics, incident response, and selective backups. Cross-platform, with SHA-256 manifests, chain-of-custody logging, and checkpoint/resume for failing media.
